Technical SEO.title: Google Search Console Indexing Report Missing Old June Data
Technical SEO.summary: The Google Search Console page indexing report is missing a large chunk of data from June 2026, with widespread indexing complaints reported this month. The author notes uncertainty over whether this is a reporting bug or a deeper indexing issue in Google Search.

Technical SEO.title: Search News Buzz Video Recap: Google Degrades EU Search Quality, Losing Faith In Your Site, AI Mode Match Types & Google Maps Photo Scams
Technical SEO.summary: Google confirmed it launched its biggest reduction in search quality in Europe in response to DMA laws, and published a document outlining regional differences in Google Search experiences. Google also confirmed a temporary indexing reporting bug in Search Console.

Technical SEO.title: Dashboards Available In Google Analytics
Technical SEO.summary: Google Analytics is rolling out a custom dashboards feature that lets users build their own visualizations to pull actionable insights from GA data in a single consolidated page. This is relevant for enterprise SEO teams building unified reporting views.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: What Wikipedia Reveals About AI Overviews And Web Traffic
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A University of Washington paper estimates that AI Overviews reduced search referrals to Wikipedia by about 5%, a figure Google disputes. The finding offers a rare data point on how AI-generated answers are affecting organic referral traffic at scale.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: New AI Search and SEO KPIs: 4 Signals That Guide Real Decisions
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Stas Levitan of LightSite AI outlines four first-party signals that marketers can use to connect AI bot attention with human traffic for better SEO decisions. This is directly actionable for enterprise teams trying to measure GEO and AI search performance.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: The 2003 Framework That Was Already Doing Query Fan-Out
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that using nested phrases and timely publishing can help content reach new Google searches and the longer queries AI systems generate. It frames a content strategy approach as applicable to both traditional SEO and AI-driven query expansion.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Documents Partner-Only API For Full-Web Search Results
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google developer documentation reveals a partner-only path to full-web search results via the Web Search Service API. This has implications for enterprise teams and vendors building search-integrated tools or AI agents that rely on Google data access.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI is changing media faster than marketers can measure it
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: IAB research finds advertisers are spending more on AI-driven discovery channels but their ability to measure the resulting customer journeys is lagging behind. This measurement gap is a key challenge for enterprise teams managing multi-channel organic and paid strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios analyzed citation patterns across four AI tools using a dataset of over 13,000 citations to identify which domains and content types are most frequently referenced. This kind of empirical citation data is directly actionable for GEO and AI-search visibility strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse tracks which domains receive the most citations across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI. Understanding citation distribution across platforms is essential for enterprise teams building GEO authority.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering Generative Engine Optimization in 2026: Full Guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land published a comprehensive guide to generative engine optimization covering strategies for maintaining and growing visibility in AI-powered search surfaces in 2026. As a reputable primary source, this is a strong reference for enterprise GEO planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: The Big Winners and Losers in US Website Traffic Over the Past Year
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land analyzed shifts in US website traffic across sectors over the past year, offering a macro view of which content categories and site types gained or lost organic visibility. This is useful context for enterprise SEO teams benchmarking performance against industry trends.
